content.text: Current code confirms one risky UI path: `Soft Reload Agent` is allowed even when `providerSessionId` is missing. In that case it resets renderer-owned entries/semantic/ghost state and then cannot reload committed history. That can make a transcript-disconnected pane look like it “lost progress,” but it still doesn’t explain Claude itself no longer appending JSONL.

I’m going to keep this in investigation mode and separate proven facts from guesses. The next thing I’m reading is the persistence/resume identity path, because the transcript failure and the “reverts to an old message” symptom can be different failures that reinforce each other.

I found the same pattern in code that the earlier evidence suggested: fresh Claude panes do not get a durable provider id until a JSONL entry arrives. Now I’m checking the actual persisted workspace and backups for duplicate or stale provider ids, because prior PR notes explicitly mention that as a discovered failure mode.

The current `workspace.json` already contains eight duplicate `providerSessionId` groups and five live-looking agent records with no provider id, including one Claude pane in `hackathon-bot`. That is not a theory anymore; identity corruption is present today, and it can plausibly explain wrong-history resume/preview behavior even if it is not the root cause of JSONL not being written.

A second concrete problem: the persistence code explicitly treats `providerSessionId` as legitimately duplicable in some paths, but reload/rehydrate also uses it as the durable resume key. That contradiction is dangerous; I’m reading clone/rewind/provider-switch next to see which duplicate cases are intentional and which are accidental corruption.

content.text: The related PR history confirms this is not isolated: ghost fallback, semantic rendering, stale-flow watchdogs, soft reload, session ownership pruning, rehydrate hibernation, and remap fixes all touched adjacent symptoms. I’m going to create a new umbrella issue that links those as prior mitigations and calls out the still-unexplained hard failure: live proxy/semantic with zero committed transcript.

There are already open issues for heap (#288), loading transcript (#283), resume/search identity (#96), rendering ownership (#172), and Claude upstream drift (#233). I’m making the new one narrower and more severe: “Claude live continues while JSONL transcript is absent/disconnected, corrupting durable resume identity,” with those linked as related but not duplicates.
I have enough to file it. I’ll use `bug` and `provider:claude`; the body will include concrete local artifact paths so future investigation can reproduce from the exact bundle and workspace state.

gh issue create \
  --title "Claude JSONL transcript can disconnect while proxy/semantic stream stays live, breaking resume identity" \
  --label bug \
  --label provider:claude \
  --body-file - <<'EOF'
## Summary

Claude panes can keep working through the proxy/semantic/screen channels while Agent Code receives **zero committed JSONL transcript entries**. In that state the UI can still show live progress, ghosts, semantic events, and screen-rendered prompts, but the durable transcript path is absent or disconnected. When the pane is later reloaded/resumed/reopened, Agent Code has no reliable provider transcript identity and can fall back to old history, blank history, or a wrong/stale `providerSessionId`.

This is the long-running class of bug that originally forced the ghost-record fallback work: the live channel and committed transcript channel can diverge badly enough that the app appears alive while durable resume state is already broken.

## Severity

High. This can lose apparent progress after resume/reload, corrupt the user's mental model of what is saved, and amplify memory/rendering failures because the renderer leans on semantic/ghost state for live display while JSONL never catches up.

## Concrete evidence from 2026-06-17 debug artifacts

Debug bundle:

```text
/Users/juliusolsson/.config/agent-code/debug-bundles/manual/2026-06-17T11-50-56-053-a6c70f19
```

Bundle facts:

- Agent Code session id: `a6c70f19-e093-4d91-8339-3a7c79abb79e`
- Provider kind: `claude`
- Proxy run dir:
  `/Users/juliusolsson/.config/agent-code/proxy/Users-juliusolsson-Desktop-general-hackathon-bot/shell-a6c70f19-e093-4d91-8339-3a7c79abb79e/2026-06-17T11-43-53-031Z`
- `state-snapshot.json` reports:
  - `totalEntries: 0`
  - `lastJsonlEntryAt: null`
  - `transcriptStatus: "ready"`
  - `transcriptError: null`
  - `_counts.entries: 0`
  - `_counts.ghosts: 11`
  - `_counts.semanticLog: 200`
  - `streamPhase: "awaiting-tool"`
  - pending tool: `AskUserQuestion`
- `feed-debug.jsonl` contains active live/rendering events despite zero JSONL entries:
  - `screen_update: 63`
  - `visible_rows: 13`
  - `submit: 3`
  - `flow_selected: 10`
  - `stream_phase: 36`
  - `turn_started: 8`
  - `text_delta: 49`
  - `tool_input_delta: 48`
  - `turn_completed: 8`
  - `ghost_orphan_sweep: 11`

The proxy events for that run carry Claude's upstream session header:

```text
x-claude-code-session-id: 184505cc-570f-4d45-8015-2145e839217c
```

But no matching root transcript file was found under `~/.claude/projects`:

```text
184505cc-570f-4d45-8015-2145e839217c.jsonl
```

That makes this more severe than a renderer-only stale state bug: Claude/proxy had a provider session id, Agent Code had live semantic traffic, but the committed transcript path Agent Code depends on was missing or not discoverable.

## Additional observed failed runs

Later restarted run:

```text
/Users/juliusolsson/.config/agent-code/proxy/Users-juliusolsson-Desktop-general-hackathon-bot/shell-6c04bc5d-8a8b-4ca4-9623-aad1c1ac8072/2026-06-17T11-52-57-121Z
```

- Proxy events file was around 66MB.
- Proxy events contained provider id:
  `7f09da4d-8651-4e75-bf69-233df36d6d38`
- `~/.claude/projects/-Users-juliusolsson-Desktop-general-hackathon-bot/7f09da4d-8651-4e75-bf69-233df36d6d38/subagents` existed.
- That directory contained `agent-*.meta.json` files, but no root `7f09da4d-8651-4e75-bf69-233df36d6d38.jsonl` was found during inspection.

Another later run had provider id:

```text
7dcaab9f-0b5d-45df-bcfc-2db1b7cd5138
```

No matching root JSONL was found under `~/.claude/projects` during the same inspection.

Important nuance: `~/.claude/projects` does contain many normal `.jsonl` transcripts overall, so this is not simply "Claude no longer writes flat JSONL anywhere". It appears workspace/session/path/version specific.

## Current workspace identity corruption is also present

A read-only scan of the current persisted workspace found:

```text
/Users/juliusolsson/.config/agent-code/workspace.json
sessions: 75
provider ids: 62
duplicate providerSessionId groups: 8
agent records missing providerSessionId: 5
```

Examples of duplicate durable provider ids:

```text

1a373e7d-7a66-4714-ac1e-497c849538b7 -> d4d53e1e-0354-49eb-b030-935fd9616a19:claude | 5c087ae1-1e13-4031-873a-b3f65a65f184:claude
cef609a0-8d65-4aee-8e7c-5c8c70e70745 -> 8e826a8c-135f-4655-8c10-d12d7463e16e:claude | 70417358-183a-4adb-b533-199699263806:claude

871a17a0-fa6f-4335-8206-62175b99e251 -> 5337ca6a-a110-4369-8d82-4521514f8fb0:claude | 448a18da-94a3-4dd8-b5c2-219087d350e9:claude
```

```text

```

This does not prove the JSONL disappearance cause, but it proves the resume identity layer is already in a state where wrong-history or old-history behavior is plausible.

## Relevant implementation facts

- Fresh Claude panes do **not** persist `providerSessionId` at spawn time.
- For fresh Claude, the renderer currently captures `providerSessionId` only from committed JSONL entries in `session:jsonl-entries`.
- If committed JSONL never arrives, the pane can stay live through proxy/semantic/screen channels but never gets a durable provider id in `workspace.json`.
- `historyLoader.ts` resolves Claude history as:

```text
~/.claude/projects/<sanitized-realpath-cwd>/<providerSessionId>.jsonl
```

- If that root file is missing, history load returns empty, while ghost/semantic state may still make the live pane look productive.
- Soft reload is available for Claude/Codex even when `providerSessionId` is missing. In that state it resets renderer-derived state but cannot reload committed history, which can turn an already-disconnected pane into an apparent progress loss.
- `src/main/sessions/forwarder.ts` starts subagent observation from parent `jsonl-entry` events. If the root JSONL path never emits, subagent live data may exist on disk/proxy but not enter the normal committed/subagent pipeline.

## Related issues and PRs

Related open issues:

- #288: main-process heap unbounded; heap snapshot was 681MB with 92% strings.
- #283: startup/resume stuck at `loading transcript`.
- #96: resume/session search identity surfaces are inconsistent.
- #172: feed render ownership across committed transcript, semantic live/history, ghosts, and optimistic input.
- #233: Claude Code 2.1.181 newer than accepted 2.1.143; upstream compatibility needs review.

Related merged PRs / prior mitigations:

- #7: render orphaned ghost fallback entries.
- #25: filter title-generation sidecar flows leaking into transcript.
- #38: stale-flow watchdog.
- #48: main-process memory growth/heap pressure watchdog.
- #62: include proxy-events tail in debug bundles.
- #65: soft reload agent command.
- #66: render orphan ghosts when JSONL stalls past proxy.
- #70: prune unowned persisted sessions.
- #87: stream JSONL transcript parsing instead of readFile.
- #142: session preview pane and stale-preview request token fixes.
- #165/#170/#184/#186: semantic-first rendering and ownership fixes.
- #258: hibernate detached sessions on rehydrate. This PR also noted duplicate `providerSessionId` rows during diagnosis.
- #274: session-id relationship/pin remap fixes.
- #277: subagent fleet rendering. Follow-up inspection found the watcher still read full files and retained all parsed entries, which can amplify heap pressure.

## Working hypotheses to investigate, not conclusions

1. Claude Code may sometimes create/advertise a session id over the API/proxy before or without creating the expected root JSONL transcript file.
2. Claude Code may now write some sessions under a different path/layout for certain workspaces, versions, or subagent-heavy runs. The presence of `session-id/subagents/*.meta.json` without the root `session-id.jsonl` is suspicious.
3. Agent Code may miss a freshly-created root JSONL file if the file appears before the fresh-session tailer snapshots/watches the project directory. A local hardening patch now treats files with `mtime/ctime >= spawnStart` as candidates, but this only covers a narrow race and does not explain runs where the file is absent.
4. Agent Code's durable identity model is too dependent on committed JSONL. The proxy header has the provider session id earlier than JSONL; that id should probably be captured as provisional durable identity, then reconciled with JSONL rather than ignored until JSONL arrives.
5. Duplicate `providerSessionId` rows in `workspace.json` can cause wrong-history resume/preview behavior even after JSONL begins working again. Some duplicates are intentional clone/rewind/provider-switch products, but reload/rehydrate also treat the field as a unique resume identity, so this needs a stricter invariant or explicit lineage model.
6. Soft reload should not destructively clear a pane with no provider id unless it can preserve/replay semantic/ghost state or tell the user that no committed transcript exists.
7. Heap pressure is likely a multiplier, not necessarily the root cause: large proxy events, retained tool outputs, ghost/semantic fallbacks, and subagent watcher retention can make a disconnected transcript state much worse.

## Suggested investigation plan

- Build a read-only diagnostic that correlates, per live/debug session:
  - Agent Code `sessionId`
  - Claude proxy `x-claude-code-session-id`
  - expected project dir from `realpath(cwd)` + sanitizer
  - root JSONL existence/mtime/size
  - nested session dir existence
  - subagent meta/body existence
  - renderer `providerSessionId`
  - workspace metadata owners and duplicates
- Add a debug bundle section that records the expected Claude transcript path and whether it existed at capture time.
- Add main-process telemetry for fresh Claude sessions:
  - when proxy first observes `x-claude-code-session-id`
  - when tailer attaches to a file
  - when first JSONL entry arrives
  - when no JSONL appears after N seconds despite semantic/proxy activity
- Review Claude Code 2.1.179/2.1.181 storage behavior against our accepted support matrix (#233). Confirm whether transcript file layout or flush timing changed upstream.
- Audit workspace persistence for duplicate `providerSessionId` semantics. Decide whether duplicates are illegal, legal only with explicit clone lineage, or legal but must never participate in resume lookup without disambiguation.
- Guard or redesign soft reload when `providerSessionId` is absent.
- Add a failing regression harness with a fake Claude/proxy session that emits semantic/proxy events but no root JSONL, then verify the UI surfaces "live but not durable" instead of silently claiming transcript is ready.

## Acceptance criteria

- A fresh Claude pane that has live proxy/semantic traffic but no JSONL transcript visibly reports that the committed transcript is disconnected/not durable.
- Agent Code captures the provider session id from the earliest trustworthy source and persists it with provenance, without pretending history is reloadable until the transcript path is confirmed.
- Rehydrate/reload cannot silently resume a different/old transcript because of duplicate or stale `providerSessionId` metadata.
- Soft reload cannot erase the only visible progress for a pane that has no committed transcript path.
- Debug bundles contain enough path/session correlation to determine whether Claude did not write JSONL, wrote it somewhere else, or Agent Code failed to attach.
- Heap behavior remains bounded when JSONL is absent and semantic/ghost/proxy streams are large.
EOF

semanticHistory.text:
**Track D Findings**
- `x-claude-code-session-id` is captured by the proxy before any JSONL dependency. `mitmAddon.py` allowlists it, lowercases headers, and writes it into request events: `packages/claude-code-headless/src/proxy/mitmAddon.py:70`, `packages/claude-code-headless/src/proxy/mitmAddon.py:179`, `packages/claude-code-headless/src/proxy/mitmAddon.py:426`.
- The proxy can observe the header, but current code does not promote it. `ProxyServer` polls `proxy-events.jsonl` and emits parsed raw events: `packages/claude-code-headless/src/proxy/proxyServer.ts:312`, then `ClaudeSession` forwards them only into `headless.handleProxyTransportEvent`: `src/providers/claude/runtime/claudeSession.ts:409`.
- `ClaudeProxyAdapter` receives request headers only as attribution-policy input, then discards them from flow state. Default attribution checks only `/v1/messages` and host, not the session header: `packages/claude-code-headless/src/proxy/ClaudeProxyAdapter.ts:192`, `packages/claude-code-headless/src/proxy/ClaudeProxyAdapter.ts:220`, `packages/claude-code-headless/src/proxy/ClaudeProxyAdapter.ts:662`.
- No existing semantic/screen/committed event includes provider session identity. Semantic event types cover turn/block/flow diagnostics, not session headers: `packages/claude-code-headless/src/channels/SemanticChannel.ts:96`; screen is visual-only: `packages/claude-code-headless/src/channels/ScreenChannel.ts:13`; committed is JSONL-only: `packages/claude-code-headless/src/channels/CommittedChannel.ts:16`.

**Main/Renderer Path**
- Main forwards `semantic-event` and coalesced `jsonl-entry` separately; there is no raw proxy/header IPC: `src/main/sessions/forwarder.ts:39`, `src/main/sessions/forwarder.ts:61`.
- Renderer captures Claude `providerSessionId` only from JSONL entry `sessionId` fields in the bulk JSONL handler: `src/renderer/src/workspace/hook/ipc/useIpcSubscriptions.ts:996`, `src/renderer/src/workspace/hook/ipc/useIpcSubscriptions.ts:1006`.
- If JSONL is absent, fresh runtime still starts with `transcriptStatus: 'ready'`, `totalEntries: 0`, and `lastJsonlEntryAt: null`: `src/renderer/src/workspace/workspaceState.ts:566`, `src/renderer/src/workspace/workspaceState.ts:609`, `src/renderer/src/workspace/workspaceState.ts:624`.
- Semantic can continue rendering independently: IPC folds semantic events into `runtime.semantic`, phase, ghosts, unread state, and feed-debug: `src/renderer/src/workspace/hook/ipc/useIpcSubscriptions.ts:663`, `src/renderer/src/workspace/hook/ipc/useIpcSubscriptions.ts:775`, `src/renderer/src/workspace/hook/ipc/useIpcSubscriptions.ts:854`.
- When semantic completes without JSONL, renderer archives bounded semantic history (`20`) and log (`200`) but does not persist provider identity: `src/renderer/src/workspace/semantic/helpers.ts:22`, `src/renderer/src/workspace/semantic/foldEvent.ts:871`, `src/renderer/src/workspace/semantic/foldEvent.ts:982`.

**Retention**
- Full proxy logs live under `~/.config/agent-code/proxy/<project>/<session>/<run>/proxy-events.jsonl`: `src/main/storage/paths.ts:41`, `packages/claude-code-headless/src/proxy/proxyServer.ts:489`.
- Debug bundle reader picks the latest matching run by `proxy-events.jsonl` mtime and includes only a 5 MiB tail when oversized: `src/main/storage/proxyEventsReader.ts:72`, `src/main/storage/proxyEventsReader.ts:111`, `src/main/storage/proxyEventsReader.ts:199`.
- If the expected session segment is missing, bundle lookup scans all session dirs and may intentionally return a nearby/wrong log instead of none: `src/main/storage/proxyEventsReader.ts:137`.
- Retention treats proxy captures as cache: default TTL 48h, budget 10-15 GiB total, proxy gets 28%, active grace 10 min, and pruning deletes whole run dirs while skipping `_shared-conf`: `src/main/storage/debugRetention.ts:21`, `src/main/storage/debugRetention.ts:187`, `src/main/storage/debugRetention.ts:344`, `src/main/storage/debugRetention.ts:405`.

**Recommendations**
- Add a first-class `provider_session_observed` event at the proxy boundary when a request has `headers['x-claude-code-session-id']`; include `{ providerSessionId, flowId, source: 'proxy-header', observedAt, cwd/sessionKey }`.
- Emit it from `ClaudeSession` or `ClaudeCodeHeadless` before the adapter drops headers, then forward through `SessionManager`/IPC so renderer can persist a provisional `providerSessionId` with provenance.
- Add a “semantic active but JSONL absent” watchdog: if proxy semantic events or `stream_phase !== idle` occur and `lastJsonlEntryAt === null` after N seconds, mark transcript disconnected instead of `ready`.
- Log expected transcript path alongside the proxy header in debug bundles: cwd project dir, `<providerSessionId>.jsonl` existence, size, mtime, and subagent dir existence.
- Add a reconciliation invariant: proxy-header id may seed durable identity, but history should be marked reloadable only after the root JSONL path exists or the loader confirms an alternate layout.
